**Testing Period:** Excess Cash Flow shall be calculated annually, commencing with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025 (the first full fiscal year following the Closing Date).
**Payment Timing:** The Excess Cash Flow prepayment shall be due and payable within 10 Business Days following delivery of the annual audited financial statements and the related Compliance Certificate for the applicable fiscal year.
**Minimum Threshold:** No Excess Cash Flow sweep shall be required in respect of any fiscal year in which Excess Cash Flow (before application of the sweep percentage) is less than \$2,000,000 (\$2.0 million). For the avoidance of doubt, the \$2.0 million minimum threshold shall apply to the gross Excess Cash Flow amount, not the net sweep amount after application of the applicable percentage.
**Voluntary Prepayment Credit:** Voluntary prepayments of the Term Loan A (and any outstanding DDTL draws) made during the applicable fiscal year shall reduce the Excess Cash Flow payment obligation for such fiscal year on a dollar-for-dollar basis.
**Section 10.2 --- Asset Sale Proceeds**
Net Cash Proceeds from asset sales in excess of the permitted basket set forth in Section 9.6 (i.e., in excess of \$3,000,000 in the aggregate per fiscal year, or in excess of \$1,000,000 per individual transaction) shall be applied to mandatory prepayment of the Credit Facilities at 100% of such Net Cash Proceeds, subject to a 365-day reinvestment period. Net Cash Proceeds need not be applied to mandatory prepayment if the Borrower has committed to reinvest such proceeds in assets useful in its business within 365 days of receipt, and such reinvestment is completed within such period (or, if committed in writing within such 365-day period, within an additional 180 days thereafter).
**Section 10.3 --- Debt Proceeds**
100% of the net cash proceeds received by the Borrower or any of its subsidiaries from the issuance or incurrence of any indebtedness that is not otherwise permitted under the Credit Agreement shall be applied to mandatory prepayment of the Credit Facilities.
**Section 10.4 --- Insurance and Condemnation Proceeds**
100% of Net Cash Proceeds from insurance recoveries and condemnation awards received by the Borrower or any of its subsidiaries in excess of \$500,000 per occurrence shall be applied to mandatory prepayment of the Credit Facilities, subject to a 270-day reinvestment period. Net Cash Proceeds need not be applied to mandatory prepayment if the Borrower reinvests such proceeds in the repair, restoration, or replacement of the applicable assets within 270 days of receipt. The 270-day reinvestment period shall commence on the date of receipt of the applicable insurance or condemnation proceeds.
**Section 10.5 --- Application of Mandatory Prepayments**
Mandatory prepayments under this Section 10 shall be applied in the following order of priority: first, to the outstanding principal balance of the Term Loan A (in direct order of maturity of remaining scheduled amortization payments); second, to the outstanding principal balance of any drawn DDTL amounts (in direct order of maturity of remaining scheduled amortization payments); and third, to outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Facility. Mandatory prepayments from asset sale proceeds and debt proceeds shall result in a corresponding permanent reduction in commitments (in the case of the Revolving Credit Facility), but mandatory prepayments from Excess Cash Flow sweeps shall not reduce Revolving Credit Facility commitments.
No prepayment premium or penalty shall be imposed on mandatory prepayments, subject to customary SOFR breakage costs.
**[Section 11 --- Financial Covenants]**
**Section 11.1 --- Total Net Leverage Ratio**
**Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio.** The Borrower shall maintain, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter (commencing with the first full fiscal quarter ending after the Closing Date), a Total Net Leverage Ratio of not greater than the applicable level set forth below:
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Test Period**                                                                            **Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio**
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------
  Closing through the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2026                                   4.75x
  Fiscal quarter ending June 30, 2026 through fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026       4.50x
  Fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2026 through fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2027   4.25x
  Fiscal quarter ending December 31, 2027 and each fiscal quarter thereafter                 4.00x
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**Definition --- Total Net Leverage Ratio:** The \"Total Net Leverage Ratio\" means, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) Total Funded Debt as of such date minus Unrestricted Cash as of such date (provided that the amount of Unrestricted Cash netted against Total Funded Debt shall in no event exceed \$15,000,000 (\$15.0 million)) to (b) LTM Adjusted EBITDA for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters most recently ended on or prior to such date.
**Total Funded Debt** means, as of any date of determination, all indebtedness for borrowed money of the Borrower and its subsidiaries that is funded and outstanding as of such date, including without limitation the outstanding principal balance of the Term Loan A, any drawn amounts under the DDTL, any drawn amounts under the Revolving Credit Facility, capital lease obligations, and other funded debt obligations, but excluding undrawn commitments, undrawn letters of credit, and contingent obligations.
**Unrestricted Cash** means, as of any date of determination, unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Borrower and its subsidiaries held in deposit accounts or securities accounts that are subject to a first-priority perfected lien in favor of the Administrative Agent for the benefit of the Lenders, net of any amounts that are subject to restrictions on use (including amounts held in escrow, restricted accounts, or trust accounts).
**LTM Adjusted EBITDA** means Adjusted EBITDA for the most recently completed period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending on the applicable test date, calculated on a consolidated basis for the Borrower and its subsidiaries. \"Adjusted EBITDA\" shall be defined in the definitive Credit Agreement to mean net income, plus interest expense, income tax expense, depreciation, and amortization, with customary add-backs and adjustments, including without limitation add-backs for (i) non-recurring charges, restructuring charges, and transaction expenses, (ii) projected cost savings and synergies (capped at 20% of Adjusted EBITDA and subject to customary requirements that such cost savings or synergies be reasonably identifiable and reasonably anticipated to be realized within 18 months of the applicable action), (iii) stock-based compensation expense, and (iv) other items to be agreed upon in the definitive Credit Agreement.
**Section 11.2 --- Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio**
**Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio:** The Borrower shall maintain, as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio of not less than 1.20x.
**Testing Commencement:** The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio shall be tested commencing with the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2025 (the first full fiscal quarter ending after the Closing Date).
**Definition --- Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio:** The \"Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio\" means, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, the ratio of (a) Adjusted EBITDA minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures minus Cash Taxes Paid, to (b) Scheduled Debt Amortization plus Cash Interest Expense, in each case for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters most recently ended on such date.
> \"Unfinanced Capital Expenditures\" means capital expenditures of the Borrower and its subsidiaries that are not funded with the proceeds of indebtedness (other than revolving loans drawn under the Revolving Credit Facility).
>
> \"Cash Taxes Paid\" means income taxes actually paid in cash by the Borrower and its subsidiaries during the applicable four-quarter period.
>
> \"Scheduled Debt Amortization\" means regularly scheduled principal payments of indebtedness of the Borrower and its subsidiaries during the applicable four-quarter period, excluding any voluntary prepayments and mandatory prepayments (other than scheduled amortization).
>
> \"Cash Interest Expense\" means interest expense actually paid in cash by the Borrower and its subsidiaries during the applicable four-quarter period, excluding non-cash interest items such as amortization of deferred financing costs, amortization of original issue discount, and non-cash accruals.
**Section 11.3 --- Minimum Liquidity**
**Minimum Liquidity:** The Borrower shall maintain, at all times, Liquidity of not less than \$10,000,000 (\$10.0 million).
**Definition --- Liquidity:** \"Liquidity\" means, as of any date of determination, the sum of (a) unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Borrower and its subsidiaries held in deposit accounts or securities accounts that are subject to a first-priority perfected lien in favor of the Administrative Agent, plus (b) the unused and available commitments under the Revolving Credit Facility (after giving effect to all outstanding borrowings and letters of credit under the Revolving Credit Facility).
The Minimum Liquidity covenant shall be tested at all times (not limited to fiscal quarter-end test dates). A breach of the Minimum Liquidity covenant at any time shall constitute an Event of Default under the Credit Agreement.
**Section 11.4 --- Equity Cure Rights**
The Sponsor (Whitmore Capital Partners Fund V, LP, or any of its affiliates) shall have the right to cure a financial covenant default by making a cash equity contribution to the Borrower (an \"Equity Cure Contribution\") within 15 Business Days after delivery of the Compliance Certificate demonstrating non-compliance with the applicable financial covenant. An Equity Cure Contribution shall be deemed added to Adjusted EBITDA for purposes of calculating the applicable financial covenant for the relevant fiscal quarter (and, to the extent applicable, for any four-quarter period including such fiscal quarter). The equity cure rights shall be subject to the following limitations:
> \(a\) No more than 2 Equity Cure Contributions may be made in any rolling period of four consecutive fiscal quarters;
>
> \(b\) No more than 4 Equity Cure Contributions may be made during the entire term of the Credit Facilities;
>
> \(c\) No Equity Cure Contribution may be made in respect of two consecutive fiscal quarters;
>
> \(d\) The minimum amount of each Equity Cure Contribution shall be the amount necessary to achieve compliance with the applicable financial covenant; and
>
> \(e\) Equity cure rights shall not be available if a Payment Event of Default (failure to pay principal, interest, or fees when due) or a Bankruptcy Event of Default (bankruptcy or insolvency of the Borrower or any material subsidiary) exists and is continuing.
**[Section 12 --- Events of Default]**
The definitive Credit Agreement shall contain Events of Default customary for transactions of this type, including, without limitation, the following:
> \(a\) *Payment Defaults:* Failure to pay (i) principal of any loan when due, or (ii) interest, fees, or other amounts within 5 Business Days after the date due;
>
> \(b\) *Financial Covenant Defaults:* Breach of any financial covenant set forth in Section 11 (no cure or grace period, except as provided in the equity cure provisions of Section 11.4);
>
> \(c\) *Negative Covenant Defaults:* Breach of any negative covenant set forth in Section 9 (no cure or grace period);
>
> \(d\) *Other Covenant Defaults:* Breach of any other affirmative covenant or provision of the Credit Agreement (subject to a 30-day cure period after notice from the Administrative Agent or any Lender);
>

**[Section 1.02 --- Other Interpretive Provisions]**
For purposes of this Agreement, the following rules of interpretation shall apply:
\(a\) The words \"hereof,\" \"herein,\" \"hereunder,\" and words of similar import, when used in this Agreement, shall refer to this Agreement as a whole and not to any particular provision of this Agreement.
\(b\) The words \"include,\" \"includes,\" and \"including\" shall be deemed to be followed by the phrase \"without limitation.\"
\(c\) References to any Section, Article, Exhibit, or Schedule shall refer to Sections, Articles, Exhibits, and Schedules of or to this Agreement unless otherwise specified.
\(d\) References to any Person include the successors and permitted assigns of that Person.
\(e\) The definitions of terms herein shall apply equally to the singular and plural forms of the terms defined. Whenever the context may require, any pronoun shall include the corresponding masculine, feminine, and neuter forms.
\(f\) Section headings used herein are for convenience of reference only, are not part of this Agreement, and shall not affect the construction of, or be taken into consideration in interpreting, this Agreement.
\(g\) In the computation of periods of time from a specified date to a later specified date, the word \"from\" means \"from and including\"; the words \"to\" and \"until\" each mean \"to but excluding\"; and the word \"through\" means \"to and including.\"
\(h\) Unless otherwise expressly provided herein, (i) references to Organization Documents, agreements, and other contractual instruments shall be deemed to include all subsequent amendments, restatements, supplements, and other modifications thereto, but only to the extent such amendments, restatements, supplements, and other modifications are permitted by the Loan Documents, and (ii) references to any Applicable Law shall include all statutory and regulatory provisions consolidating, amending, replacing, or supplementing such Applicable Law.

**[Section 1.03 --- Accounting Terms]**
\(a\) All accounting terms not specifically or completely defined herein shall be construed in conformity with, and all financial data (including financial ratios and other financial calculations) required to be submitted pursuant to this Agreement shall be prepared in conformity with, GAAP as in effect from time to time, applied in a manner consistent with that used in preparing the audited financial statements of the Borrower for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024.
\(b\) If at any time any change in GAAP would affect the computation of any financial ratio or requirement set forth in any Loan Document, and either the Borrower or the Required Lenders shall so request, the Administrative Agent, the Lenders, and the Borrower shall negotiate in good faith to amend such ratio or requirement to preserve the original intent thereof in light of such change in GAAP; *provided* that, until so amended, (i) such ratio or requirement shall continue to be computed in accordance with GAAP as in effect prior to such change and (ii) the Borrower shall provide to the Administrative Agent and the Lenders financial statements and other documents required under this Agreement setting forth a reconciliation between calculations of such ratio or requirement made before and after giving effect to such change in GAAP.

**[Section 1.06 --- SOFR Benchmark Replacement]**
\(a\) **Benchmark Replacement.** Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement or any other Loan Document, if a Benchmark Transition Event occurs with respect to SOFR, then the Administrative Agent and the Borrower may amend this Agreement to replace SOFR with a Benchmark Replacement. Any such amendment will become effective at 5:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) Business Day after the Administrative Agent has posted such proposed amendment to all Lenders and the Borrower, so long as the Administrative Agent has not received, by such time, written notice of objection to such amendment from Lenders comprising the Required Lenders. No replacement of SOFR with a Benchmark Replacement will occur prior to the applicable Benchmark Transition Start Date.
\(b\) **Benchmark Replacement.** The \"Benchmark Replacement\" shall be the sum of: (i) the alternate benchmark rate that has been selected by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower as the replacement for SOFR giving due consideration to (A) any selection or recommendation of a replacement benchmark rate or the mechanism for determining such a rate by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, or any committee officially endorsed or convened by any of the foregoing, including the Alternative Reference Rates Committee (\"**ARRC**\"), and (B) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for determining a benchmark rate as a replacement for SOFR for U.S. dollar-denominated syndicated credit facilities at such time, and (ii) the related Benchmark Replacement Adjustment; *provided* that, if such Benchmark Replacement as so determined would be less than the floor set forth in the definition of \"SOFR\" (i.e., 1.00% per annum), such Benchmark Replacement will be deemed to be such floor for the purposes of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.
\(c\) **Benchmark Replacement Adjustment.** The \"Benchmark Replacement Adjustment\" shall be the spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment (which may be a positive or negative value or zero), that has been selected by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, giving due consideration to (i) any selection or recommendation of a spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of SOFR by ARRC or (ii) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for determining a spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of SOFR for U.S. dollar-denominated syndicated credit faciliti

es at such time.
\(d\) **Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes.** In connection with the use, administration, adoption, or implementation of a Benchmark Replacement, the Administrative Agent will have the right to make Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes from time to time and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein or in any other Loan Document, any amendments implementing such Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes will become effective without any further action or consent of any other party to this Agreement or any other Loan Document. \"Benchmark Replacement Conforming Changes\" means, with respect to any Benchmark Replacement, any technical, administrative, or operational changes (including changes to the definition of \"Base Rate,\" the definition of \"Business Day,\" the definition of \"Interest Period,\" timing and frequency of determining rates and making payments of interest, timing of borrowing requests or prepayment, conversion or continuation notices, the applicability and length of lookback periods, and other technical, administrative, or operational matters) that the Administrative Agent decides may be appropriate to reflect the adoption and implementation of such Benchmark Replacement.
\(e\) **Benchmark Transition Event.** A \"Benchmark Transition Event\" means the occurrence of one or more of the following events with respect to SOFR: (i) a public statement or publication of information by or on behalf of the administrator of SOFR announcing that such administrator has ceased or will cease to provide SOFR, permanently or indefinitely, *provided* that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide SOFR; (ii) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of SOFR, the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, an insolvency official with jurisdiction over the administrator for SOFR, a resolution authority with jurisdiction over the administrator for SOFR, or a court or an entity with similar insolvency or resolution authority over the administrator for SOFR, which states that the administrator of SOFR has ceased or will cease to provide SOFR permanently or indefinitely, *provided* that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide SOFR; or (iii) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of SOFR announcing that SOFR is no longer representative.
\(f\) **Benchmark Transition Start Date.** The \"Benchmark Transition Start Date\" means the earlier of (i) the applicable Benchmark Replacement Date and (ii) if applicable, the date that is ninety (90) days prior to the expected date identified in the public statement or publication described in clause (e) above (or, if the expected date is fewer than ninety (90) days after the date of such statement or publication, the date of such statement or publication).

\(a\) Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each Lender having a Revolving Commitment severally (and not jointly) agrees to make revolving loans (each, a \"Revolving Loan\") to the Borrower from time to time on or after the Closing Date until and including the Maturity Date applicable to the Revolving Credit Facility, in an aggregate principal amount at any one time outstanding that will not result in such Lender\'s Revolving Credit Exposure exceeding such Lender\'s Revolving Commitment. The aggregate Revolving Commitments as of the Closing Date are \$50,000,000. At no time shall the sum of the aggregate outstanding principal amount of all Revolving Loans plus all LC Obligations exceed the Maximum Revolver Amount.
\(b\) Amounts repaid in respect of the Revolving Loans may be reborrowed from time to time prior to the Maturity Date, subject to the terms and conditions hereof.
\(c\) As of the Closing Date, \$3,200,000 of the Revolving Credit Facility shall be utilized in connection with the issuance of Letters of Credit deemed issued hereunder pursuant to Section 2.04. The Borrower does not anticipate drawing Revolving Loans on the Closing Date.
\(d\) Revolving Loans may be SOFR Loans or Base Rate Loans, as the Borrower may request in accordance with Section 2.16.
**[Section 2.03 --- Delayed Draw Term Loan Commitments]**
\(a\) Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each Lender having a DDTL Commitment severally (and not jointly) agrees to make delayed draw term loans (each, a \"DDTL\" or \"Delayed Draw Term Loan\") to the Borrower from time to time during the Availability Period in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding such Lender\'s DDTL Commitment as set forth on Schedule 2.01. The aggregate DDTL Commitments are \$50,000,000.
\(b\) The DDTL may be drawn in up to three (3) separate draws, each in a minimum principal amount of \$10,000,000 (or, if less, the entire remaining undrawn DDTL Commitment). Each draw of the DDTL shall be made pro rata among the Lenders based on their respective DDTL Commitments.
\(c\) The proceeds of each DDTL borrowing shall be used solely to finance Permitted Acquisitions and the costs and expenses directly related thereto. No DDTL borrowing may be used for any other purpose.
\(d\) The Availability Period shall expire on May 30, 2026 (the date that is twelve (12) months after the Closing Date). Any DDTL Commitments that are undrawn at the expiration of the Availability Period shall automatically and permanently terminate. No DDTL may be drawn after the expiration of the Availability Period.
\(e\) Once repaid or prepaid, no portion of the DDTL may be reborrowed. The DDTL Commitment of each Lender shall be permanently reduced by the amount of any DDTL borrowing made by such Lender.
\(f\) Each draw of the DDTL shall be subject to the satisfaction (or waiver) of the conditions set forth in Section 3.02.
**[Section 2.04 --- Letters of Credit]**
\(a\) **General.** Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, the Borrower may request the Administrative Agent (or a fronting bank designated by the Administrative Agent, the \"LC Issuer\") to issue standby letters of credit (each, a \"Letter of Credit\") for the account of the Borrower from time to time on or after the Closing Date until and including the date that is thirty (30) days prior to the Maturity Date applicable to the Revolving Credit Facility. Letters of Credit shall be denominated in Dollars and shall be in such form as is acceptable to the LC Issuer. No Letter of Credit shall have an expiration date later than the earlier of (i) one year after the date of issuance thereof (subject to renewal) and (ii) five (5) Business Days prior to the Maturity Date. The aggregate undrawn amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit at any one time shall not exceed \$10,000,000 (the \"LC Sublimit\").
\(b\) **Existing Letters of Credit.** Schedule 2.04 sets forth the existing letters of credit of the Borrower in an aggregate stated amount of \$3,200,000, which shall be deemed issued hereunder on the Closing Date and shall constitute Letters of Credit for all purposes of this Agreement.
\(c\) **Issuance; Amendment; Renewal; Extension.** Each issuance, amendment, renewal, or extension of a Letter of Credit shall be subject to (i) three (3) Business Days\' prior notice (or such shorter period as the LC Issuer may agree), (ii) satisfaction of the conditions in Section 3.02, and (iii) execution and delivery of a Letter of Credit application in form satisfactory to the LC Issuer.
\(d\) **Reimbursement.** If the LC Issuer makes a payment under any Letter of Credit, the Borrower shall reimburse the LC Issuer in an amount equal to such drawing no later than 1:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the Business Day immediately following the date of such drawing (or, if the Borrower received notice of such drawing before 10:00 a.m. on the date of such drawing, on such date). Any amount not so reimbursed shall be deemed a Revolving Loan (initially a Base Rate Loan) made by the LC Issuer. Each Lender with a Revolving Commitment shall be obligated to fund its pro rata share of any unreimbursed drawing.
\(e\) **Participations.** By the issuance of a Letter of Credit, the LC Issuer shall be deemed, without further action, to have granted to each other Lender with a Revolving Commitment a participation in such Letter of Credit equal to such Lender\'s pro rata share. Each such Lender agrees to fund its participation in the amount of any unreimbursed drawing under a Letter of Credit upon one (1) Business Day\'s notice from the LC Issuer.
\(f\) **Cash Collateralization.** If (i) any Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing or (ii) the Revolving Commitments shall have been terminated, the Borrower shall, upon demand by the Administrative Agent, deposit in a cash collateral account an amount equal to 103% of the aggregate LC Obligations.
**[Section 2.05 --- Prepayments]**
**(a) Voluntary Prepayments**
\(i\) The Borrower may, upon not less than three (3) Business Days\' prior irrevocable written notice to the Administrative Agent (or one (1) Business Day in the case of Base Rate Loans), prepay the Term Loan A and the DDTL (if drawn) in whole or in part, without premium or penalty. Each partial prepayment of SOFR Loans shall be in a principal amount of not less than \$1,000,000 and in integral multiples of \$500,000 in excess thereof. Each partial prepayment of Base Rate Loans shall be in a principal amount of not less than \$500,000 and in integral multiples of \$100,000 in excess thereof.
\(ii\) Voluntary prepayments of the Term Loan A and the DDTL shall be applied to the remaining scheduled amortization payments in direct order of maturity (i.e., applied first to the next scheduled installment and then to successive installments in chronological order); *provided* that the Borrower may, at its election stated in the notice of prepayment, direct that such voluntary prepayment be applied in inverse order of maturity.
\(iii\) Revolving Loans may be prepaid at any time without penalty, subject to Section 2.17 with respect to SOFR Loans.
\(iv\) Voluntary prepayments of the Term Loan A and the DDTL shall be applied pro rata between the Term Loan A and the DDTL (if drawn) based on their respective aggregate outstanding principal amounts.
**(b) Mandatory Prepayments**
\(i\) **Excess Cash Flow.** Commencing with the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, within ten (10) Business Days after the date on which the Borrower delivers the audited financial statements for such fiscal year pursuant to Section 5.01(a), the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans (as hereinafter defined) in an amount equal to the applicable ECF Percentage of Excess Cash Flow for such fiscal year. As used herein, \"ECF Percentage\" means (A) 50% if the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of such fiscal year is equal to or greater than 4.00 to 1.00, (B) 25% if the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of such fiscal year is less than 4.00 to 1.00 but equal to or greater than 3.50 to 1.00, and (C) 0% if the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of such fiscal year is less than 3.50 to 1.00. The Borrower shall deliver, together with each Excess Cash Flow prepayment, a certificate of a Responsible Officer setting forth in reasonable detail the calculation of Excess Cash Flow for such fiscal year and the ECF Percentage applicable thereto.
\(ii\) **Asset Sales.** Within ten (10) Business Days following the receipt by the Borrower or any Subsidiary of Net Cash Proceeds from any Disposition not otherwise permitted under Section 7.05(a) through (e) in excess of \$1,000,000 per transaction (or series of related transactions), the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans in an amount equal to 100% of such Net Cash Proceeds; *provided* that (A) the aggregate Net Cash Proceeds from Dispositions of non-core assets in any fiscal year that do not exceed \$3,000,000 in the aggregate shall not be subject to mandatory prepayment, and (B) if the Borrower delivers to the Administrative Agent a written reinvestment notice within ten (10) Business Days following receipt of such Net Cash Proceeds, stating that the Borrower or such Subsidiary intends to reinvest such Net Cash Proceeds in assets useful in the business of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, then the Borrower shall not be required to prepay the Term Loans with such Net Cash Proceeds so long as such Net Cash Proceeds are so reinvested within three hundred sixty-five (365) days following receipt thereof. Any Net Cash Proceeds not so reinvested within such 365-day period shall be applied to prepay the Term Loans within five (5) Business Days after the expiration of such period.
\(iii\) **Debt Proceeds.** Within five (5) Business Days following the receipt by the Borrower or any Subsidiary of any net cash proceeds from the incurrence of any Indebtedness not permitted under Section 7.02, the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans in an amount equal to 100% of such net cash proceeds.
\(iv\) **Insurance and Condemnation Proceeds.** Within ten (10) Business Days following the receipt by the Borrower or any Subsidiary of Net Cash Proceeds in excess of \$500,000 per occurrence from insurance recoveries or condemnation awards (other than proceeds received in respect of business interruption insurance, which shall not be subject to mandatory prepayment), the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans in an amount equal to 100% of such Net Cash Proceeds; *provided* that if the Borrower delivers to the Administrative Agent a written reinvestment notice within ten (10) Business Days following receipt of such Net Cash Proceeds, stating that the Borrower or such Subsidiary intends to reinvest such Net Cash Proceeds in the repair, restoration, or replacement of the affected assets or in other assets useful in the business of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, then the Borrower shall not be required to prepay the Term Loans with such Net Cash Proceeds so long as such Net Cash Proceeds are so reinvested within one hundred eighty (180) days following receipt thereof. Any Net Cash Proceeds not so reinvested within such 180-day period shall be applied to prepay the Term Loans within five (5) Business Days after the expiration of such period.
\(v\) **Application of Mandatory Prepayments.** All mandatory prepayments under this Section 2.05(b) shall be applied pro rata between the Term Loan A and the DDTL (if drawn) based on their respective aggregate outstanding principal amounts, and within each such facility, shall be applied to the remaining scheduled amortization payments in direct order of maturity. As used in this Section 2.05, \"Term Loans\" means, collectively, the Term Loan A and the DDTL (to the extent drawn and outstanding).

**[Section 2.08 --- Interest]**
**(a) Pricing Grid / Applicable Rate**
**Term Loan A and DDTL.** Each Term Loan A and each DDTL that is a SOFR Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to SOFR (subject to a floor of 1.00% per annum) plus 3.75%. Each Term Loan A and each DDTL that is a Base Rate Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the Base Rate plus 2.75%.
**Revolving Loans.** Each Revolving Loan that is a SOFR Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to SOFR (subject to a floor of 1.00% per annum) plus the Applicable Rate determined by reference to the following pricing grid:
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **Level**         **Total Net Leverage Ratio**         **SOFR Applicable Rate**   **Base Rate Applicable Rate**
  ----------------- ------------------------------------ -------------------------- -------------------------------
  I                 Greater than or equal to 3.50:1.00   3.75%                      2.75%
  II                Less than 3.50:1.00                  3.50%                      2.50%
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Applicable Rate for Revolving Loans shall be determined by the Administrative Agent based on the Total Net Leverage Ratio set forth in the most recent Compliance Certificate delivered by the Borrower pursuant to Section 5.02(a). Changes in the Applicable Rate resulting from a change in the Total Net Leverage Ratio shall become effective on the fifth (5th) Business Day following the date on which such Compliance Certificate is delivered to the Administrative Agent (each such date, an \"Adjustment Date\"). Notwithstanding the foregoing, (i) until the first Adjustment Date occurring after the delivery of the Compliance Certificate for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2025, the Applicable Rate for Revolving Loans shall be determined based on Level I (SOFR + 3.75%), and (ii) if the Borrower fails to deliver any Compliance Certificate within the time period required under Section 5.02(a), the Applicable Rate for Revolving Loans shall be determined based on Level I until the fifth Business Day after such Compliance Certificate is delivered.
**(b) Default Rate**
Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, all outstanding Obligations (including, without limitation, all outstanding principal, accrued and unpaid interest, and all fees) shall, at the election of the Required Lenders (or automatically with respect to an Event of Default under Section 8.01(f)), bear interest at the Default Rate (i.e., the otherwise applicable interest rate plus 2.00% per annum). Interest at the Default Rate shall accrue from the date of such Event of Default and shall be payable on demand.
**(c) Interest Computation and Payment**
Interest on each SOFR Loan shall be computed on the basis of a year of 360 days for the actual number of days elapsed (including the first day but excluding the last day) in the applicable period. Interest on each Base Rate Loan shall be computed on the basis of a year of 365 days (or 366 days in a leap year) for the actual number of days elapsed. Interest on each SOFR Loan shall be payable in arrears on the last day of each Interest Period applicable thereto and, in the case of any Interest Period in excess of three (3) months, on each date that is three (3) months after the commencement of such Interest Period. Interest on each Base Rate Loan shall be payable in arrears on the last Business Day of each fiscal quarter. Interest on the Loans shall also be payable upon prepayment (to the extent of the principal amount being prepaid) and on the Maturity Date.
**[Section 2.09 --- Fees]**
\(a\) **Revolving Commitment Fee.** The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the ratable account of each Lender having a Revolving Commitment, a commitment fee (the \"Commitment Fee\") equal to (i) 0.40% per annum on the average daily unused Revolving Commitments during each fiscal quarter in which the average daily Revolving Utilization is less than 50% of the aggregate Revolving Commitments, and (ii) 0.30% per annum on the average daily unused Revolving Commitments during each fiscal quarter in which the average daily Revolving Utilization is equal to or greater than 50% of the aggregate Revolving Commitments. For purposes hereof, \"unused Revolving Commitments\" means the excess of the aggregate Revolving Commitments over the sum of the aggregate outstanding Revolving Loans and LC Obligations. The Commitment Fee shall accrue from the Closing Date through and including the Maturity Date (or earlier termination of the Revolving Commitments) and shall be payable quarterly in arrears on the last Business Day of each fiscal quarter and on the Maturity Date (or the date of termination of the Revolving Commitments). The Commitment Fee shall be computed on the basis of a year of 360 days for the actual number of days elapsed.
\(b\) **DDTL Ticking Fee.** The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the ratable account of each Lender having a DDTL Commitment, a ticking fee (the \"DDTL Ticking Fee\") equal to 0.50% per annum on the daily average amount of undrawn DDTL Commitments during the Availability Period. The DDTL Ticking Fee shall accrue from the Closing Date and shall be payable quarterly in arrears on the last Business Day of each fiscal quarter and on the earlier to occur of (

i) the date on which the DDTL Commitments are fully drawn and (ii) the date on which the DDTL Commitments are terminated (including upon the expiration of the Availability Period). The DDTL Ticking Fee shall be computed on the basis of a year of 360 days for the actual number of days elapsed.
\(c\) **LC Fees.** The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the ratable account of each Lender with a Revolving Commitment, a letter of credit participation fee equal to the Applicable Rate for Revolving Loans in effect from time to time, calculated on the daily average aggregate stated amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit, payable quarterly in arrears on the last Business Day of each fiscal quarter and on the Maturity Date. In addition, the Borrower shall pay to the LC Issuer a fronting fee equal to 0.125% per annum on the daily average aggregate stated amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit issued by such LC Issuer, payable quarterly in arrears. The Borrower shall also pay to the LC Issuer customary issuance, amendment, presentation, and administration fees as agreed between the Borrower and the LC Issuer from time to time.
\(d\) **Administrative Agent Fee.** The Borrower shall pay to Ridgeline National Bank, N.A., for its own account, an annual administrative agent fee in the amount and at the times set forth in the Fee Letter.
\(e\) **Arrangement Fee.** The Borrower shall pay to Ridgeline National Bank, N.A., in its capacity as Lead Arranger and Bookrunner, an arrangement and syndication fee in the amount and at the times set forth in the Fee Letter, which fee shall be fully earned and payable on the Closing Date.
**[Section 2.10 --- Computation of Interest and Fees]**
All computations of interest on SOFR Loans and all computations of fees (including the Commitment Fee, DDTL Ticking Fee, and LC fees) shall be made on the basis of a year of 360 days for the actual number of days elapsed (including the first day but excluding the last day) in the period for which interest or fees are payable. All computations of interest on Base Rate Loans shall be made on the basis of a year of 365 days (or 366 days in a leap year) for the actual number of days elapsed. Interest shall be deemed paid as of the date on which funds in the amount of such interest payment are credited to the account of the Administrative Agent.
**[Section 2.11 --- Evidence of Indebtedness]**
\(a\) Each Lender shall maintain in accordance with its usual practice an account or accounts evidencing the Indebtedness of the Borrower to such Lender resulting from each Loan made by such Lender, including the amounts of principal and interest payable and paid to such Lender from time to time hereunder.
\(b\) The Administrative Agent shall maintain a register (the \"Register\") in which it shall record (i) the amount of each Lender\'s Commitments, (ii) the amount of each Loan made hereunder, the type thereof, and the Interest Period applicable thereto, (iii) the amount of any principal or interest due and payable or to become due and payable from the Borrower hereunder, and (iv) the amount of any sum received by the Administrative Agent hereunder for the account of the Lenders and each Lender\'s share thereof. The entries in the Register shall be conclusive absent manifest error.
\(c\) The Borrower may request that any Lender\'s Loans be evidenced by one or more promissory notes substantially in the form of Exhibit A. Upon receipt of such request, the Administrative Agent shall deliver to the Borrower for execution and delivery to such Lender one or more promissory notes payable to the order of such Lender in the applicable principal amount.
**[Section 2.12 --- Payments Generally]**
\(a\) All payments to be made by the Borrower hereunder (whether of principal, interest, fees, or reimbursement of LC disbursements) shall be made in immediately available funds, in Dollars, without setoff or counterclaim, to the Administrative Agent\'s account (as specified by the Administrative Agent from time to time) no later than 2:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the date when due. Any payment received by the Administrative Agent after 2:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) shall be deemed to have been received on the next succeeding Business Day and any applicable interest or fees shall continue to accrue.
\(b\) If any payment hereunder becomes due and payable on a day that is not a Business Day, such payment shall be extended to the next succeeding Business Day, and, with respect to payments of principal, interest thereon shall be payable at the then applicable rate during such extension.
\(c\) Upon receipt of each payment, the Administrative Agent shall promptly distribute to each Lender its pro rata share thereof in accordance with this Agreement.
\(d\) All payments shall be applied in the following order: *first*, to fees and expenses of the Administrative Agent then due; *second*, to accrued fees then due to the Lenders; *third*, to accrued and unpaid interest; and *fourth*, to outstanding principal.
**[Section 2.13 --- Sharing of Payments]**
If any Lender shall, by exercising any right of setoff or counterclaim or otherwise, obtain payment in respect of any principal of or interest on any of its Loans or other Obligations resulting in such Lender\'s receiving payment of a proportion of the aggregate amount of its Loans and accrued interest thereon greater than its pro rata share thereof, then the Lender receiving such greater proportion shall (a) notify the Administrative Agent of such fact and (b) purchase (for cash at face value) participations in the Loans and other Obligations of the other Lenders, or make such other adjustments as shall be equitable, so that the benefit of all such payments shall be shared by the Lenders ratably in accordance with the aggregate amount of principal of and accrued interest on their respective Loans and other amounts owing them. The Borrower agrees that any Lender so purchasing a participation from another Lender may, to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, exercise all its rights of payment with respect to such participation as fully as if such Lender were the direct creditor of the Borrower in the amount of such participation.
**[Section 2.14 --- Incremental Facility]**
\(a\) The Borrower may, at any time and from time to time after the Closing Date, request one or more increases to the Term Loan A facility (each, an \"Incremental Term Loan\") in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed \$40,000,000, by delivering to the Administrative Agent a written request specifying the amount, proposed terms, and proposed lenders.
\(b\) Each Incremental Term Loan shall be subject to the following conditions: (i) no Default or Event of Default shall exist at the time of the incurrence of such Incremental Term Loan or would result therefrom; (ii) after giving pro forma effect thereto, the Borrower shall be in compliance with all financial covenants set forth in Section 7.11; (iii) the yield (including interest rate margins, upfront fees, original issue discount, and SOFR floors, but excluding arrangement, structuring, and commitment fees) applicable to any Incremental Term Loan shall not exceed the yield applicable to the Term Loan A by more than 0.50% per annum (50 basis points); *provided* that this most-favored-nation pricing protection shall not apply to any Incremental Term Loan incurred after the date that is six (6) months after the Closing Date; (iv) the Incremental Term Loan shall be secured by the same Collateral and guaranteed by the same Guarantors as the existing Obligations on a pari passu basis; (v) the maturity date of the Incremental Term Loan shall be no earlier than the Term Loan A Maturity Date; (vi) the amortization of the Incremental Term Loan shall be no more onerous than that of the Term Loan A; and (vii) all other terms and conditions shall be reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
\(c\) Incremental Term Loans may be provided by existing Lenders (in their sole discretion) or by other financial institutions reasonably acceptable to the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, which shall become Lenders hereunder upon the effectiveness of such Incremental Term Loan.
\(d\) Each Incremental Term Loan shall be documented by an amendment to this Agreement signed by the Borrower, the Administrative Agent, and the Lenders providing such Incremental Term Loan, and shall not require the consent of any other Lender.
**[Section 2.15 --- Defaulting Lenders]**
\(a\) If any Lender becomes a Defaulting Lender, then, for so long as such Lender is a Defaulting Lender, the following provisions shall apply:
> \(i\) The Commitment Fee shall cease to accrue on the unfunded portion of such Defaulting Lender\'s Revolving Commitment and DDTL Commitment.
>
> \(ii\) The Revolving Commitment and outstanding Revolving Loans of such Defaulting Lender shall be disregarded for purposes of calculating the vote of the Required Lenders in connection with any amendment, waiver, consent, or direction under this Agreement; *provided* that this clause (ii) shall not apply to any amendment, waiver, or consent that (A) requires the consent of all Lenders or all affected Lenders and (B) affects such Defaulting Lender differently from the other affected Lenders.
>
> \(iii\) If any LC Obligations exist at the time a Lender becomes a Defaulting Lender, then (A) all or any part of such Defaulting Lender\'s LC Exposure shall be reallocated among the non-Defaulting Lenders in accordance with their respective pro rata shares (calculated excluding the Defaulting Lender\'s Revolving Commitment) but only to the extent that (1) the sum of each non-Defaulting Lender\'s Revolving Credit Exposure does not exceed its Revolving Commitment and (2) no Default or Event of Default exists, and (B) if the reallocation described in clause (A) cannot be fully effected, the Borrower shall, within one (1) Business Day of notice by the Administrative Agent, cash collateralize the remaining portion of such Defaulting Lender\'s LC Exposure.
>
> \(iv\) So long as a Lender is a Defaulting Lender, the LC Issuer shall not be required to issue, amend, or increase any Letter of Credit unless it is satisfied that the related exposure will be fully covered by the Revolving Commitments of the non-Defaulting Lenders and/or cash collateral provided by the Borrower.
>
> \(v\) The Borrower may, at its own expense, replace a Defaulting Lender in accordance with Section 2.19.
\(b\) If the Borrower, the Administrative Agent, and the LC Issuer agree in writing that a Defaulting Lender has adequately remedied all matters that caused such Lender to be a Defaulting Lender, then such Lender\'s Revolving Commitment and DDTL Commitment shall be readjusted to reflect such Lender\'s Revolving Commitment, and that Lender shall purchase at par such of the Revolving Loans of the other Lenders as the Administrative Agent shall determine may be necessary in order for such Lender to hold such Loans in accordance with its pro rata share.
**[Section 2.16 --- Borrowing Mechanics]**
\(a\) Each borrowing of Loans shall be made upon the Borrower\'s delivery to the Administrative Agent of a duly completed and executed Borrowing Request, substantially in the form of Exhibit B, which shall specify (i) the type of Loans to be borrowed (Term Loan A, Revolving Loan, or DDTL), (ii) whether such Loans shall be SOFR Loans or Base Rate Loans, (iii) the aggregate principal amount of such Loans, (iv) the date of such borrowing, and (v) in the case of SOFR Loans, the initial Interest Period applicable thereto.
\(b\) Borrowing Requests shall be delivered to the Administrative Agent not later than 1:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) (i) three (3) Business Days prior to the requested borrowing date in the case of SOFR Loans, and (ii) one (1) Business Day prior to the requested borrowing date in the case of Base Rate Loans.
\(c\) Minimum borrowing amounts: SOFR Loans shall be in a minimum aggregate principal amount of \$1,000,000; Base Rate Loans shall be in a minimum aggregate principal amount of \$500,000.
\(d\) Promptly upon receipt of a Borrowing Request, the Administrative Agent shall notify each applicable Lender of the details of the requested borrowing. Each Lender shall make the amount of its pro rata share of such borrowing available to the Administrative Agent in immediately available funds no later than 1:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the requested borrowing date. Upon satisfaction of the applicable conditions set forth in Article III, the Administrative Agent shall make the proceeds of such borrowing available to the Borrower.
**[Section 2.17 --- Breakage Costs]**
If any SOFR Loan is prepaid, converted to a Base Rate Loan, or fails to be borrowed or converted on the date specified in any Borrowing Request, in each case on a day other than the last day of the Interest Period applicable thereto, the Borrower shall compensate each Lender for all losses, costs, and expenses incurred by such Lender in connection with the liquidation or redeployment of deposits or other funds acquired by such Lender to fund or maintain such SOFR Loan. A certificate of a Lender setting forth any amounts payable under this Section 2.17 and the basis therefor shall be delivered to the Borrower and shall be conclusive absent manifest error. The Borrower shall pay such amounts to such Lender within ten (10) Business Days after receipt of such certificate.
**[Section 2.18 --- Taxes]**
\(a\) **Payments Free of Taxes.** Any and all payments by or on account of any obligation of any Loan Party under any Loan Document shall be made without deduction or withholding for any Taxes, except as required by Applicable Law. If any Applicable Law requires the deduction or withholding of any Tax from any such payment, then (i) the applicable Loan Party shall be entitled to make such deduction or withholding and shall timely pay the full amount deducted or withheld to the relevant Governmental Authority, and (ii) if the Tax is an Indemnified Tax, the sum payable by the applicable Loan Party shall be increased as necessary so that after such deduction or withholding has been made (including such deductions and withholdings applicable to additional sums payable under this Section), each applicable recipient receives an amount equal to the sum it would have received had no such deduction or withholding been made. > \(c\) mechanics\', materialmen\'s, carriers\', warehousemen\'s, landlords\', and other similar statutory Liens arising in the ordinary course of business securing obligations that are not overdue for a period of more than sixty (60) days or that are being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings diligently conducted;

> \(d\) easements, rights-of-way, restrictions, zoning ordinances, encroachments, and other similar encumbrances on real property imposed by Applicable Law or arising in the ordinary course of business that do not materially interfere with the use of the property affected thereby;

Create, incur, assume, or suffer to exist any Indebtedness, except:
> \(a\) Indebtedness under the Loan Documents;
>
> \(b\) Indebtedness existing on the Closing Date and set forth on Schedule 7.02, and any refinancing, renewal, or extension thereof so long as the principal amount is not increased and the maturity is not extended beyond the Term Loan A Maturity Date;
>
> \(c\) general unsecured Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding \$5,000,000 at any time outstanding;
>
> \(d\) Capital Lease Obligations in an aggregate amount not exceeding \$7,500,000 at any time outstanding;
>
> \(e\) purchase money Indebtedness secured solely by the acquired asset, in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding \$3,000,000 outstanding at any time;

> \(f\) intercompany Indebtedness among the Borrower and Guarantors, *provided* that any such Indebtedness owed by the Borrower or any Guarantor to a non-Guarantor Subsidiary shall be subordinated to the Obligations on terms reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent;

> \(h\) Indebtedness incurred in connection with Permitted Acquisitions (including assumed Indebtedness and seller financing), *provided* that, after giving pro forma effect to such Indebtedness, the Total Net Leverage Ratio does not exceed 4.00 to 1.00;

> \(i\) Incremental Loans incurred in accordance with Section 2.14;

> \(j\) other Indebtedness not otherwise described in clauses (a) through (i) above in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding \$1,000,000 at any time outstanding.

> \(b\) Investments existing on the Closing Date and set forth on a schedule to be delivered on the Closing Date;
>
> \(c\) Permitted Acquisitions in accordance with the definition thereof;
>
> \(d\) loans and advances to employees, officers, and directors in the ordinary course of business (including for travel, entertainment, and relocation) in an aggregate amount not exceeding \$500,000 at any time outstanding;

> \(e\) Investments by the Borrower in any Guarantor and Investments by any Guarantor in the Borrower or any other Guarantor;

> \(g\) deposits, prepayments, and advances to suppliers, contractors, and landlords in the ordinary course of business on terms customary in the industry;

> \(a\) any Subsidiary may merge with and into the Borrower (with the Borrower surviving);

> \(b\) any Subsidiary may merge with and into any other Subsidiary (with a Guarantor surviving);

> \(c\) Permitted Acquisitions may be structured as mergers where the Borrower or a Guarantor is the surviving entity;

> \(d\) any Subsidiary that is not a material Subsidiary and that has no material assets or liabilities may be dissolved or liquidated with the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent (not to be unreasonably withheld).

Sell, transfer, lease, license, or otherwise Dispose of any property or assets, except:

>
> \(b\) dispositions of worn-out, obsolete, or surplus equipment or other property that is no longer used or useful in the conduct of the business;

Declare or make, directly or indirectly, any Restricted Payment, except:

> \(b\) **Management Fee.** Payments to the Sponsor (or its Affiliates) for management, consulting, monitoring, and advisory fees in an aggregate amount not to exceed \$1,000,000 per fiscal year, payable in equal quarterly installments in arrears; *provided* that no such payment shall be made at any time when a Default or Event of Default exists or would result therefrom.

> \(d\) **Employee Equity Repurchases.** Repurchases of Equity Interests held by current or former employees, directors, officers, or consultants of the Borrower or its Subsidiaries (or their respective estates, heirs, or family members), in an aggregate amount not exceeding \$500,000 in any fiscal year; *provided* that no such repurchase shall be made at any time when a Default or Event of Default exists or would result therefrom.

> \(e\) **General Limitation.** Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Section 7.06, no Restricted Payment shall be declared or made if, at the time thereof or after giving effect thereto, a Default or Event of Default then exists or would result therefrom.

Enter into or permit to exist any transaction or series of related transactions with any Affiliate of any Loan Party (other than the Borrower and its Subsidiaries), except:

> \(b\) transactions expressly permitted by this Agreement, including management fee payments under Section 7.06(b) and tax distributions under Section 7.06(a);
>
> \(c\) transactions between and among the Borrower and its Subsidiaries;
>
> \(d\) employment, compensation, and benefit arrangements with officers, directors, and employees of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries entered into in the ordinary course of business and approved by the Board (or a compensation committee thereof).

Enter into or permit to exist any contractual obligation that restricts the ability of any Subsidiary to (a) make Restricted Payments or other distributions to the Borrower, (b) grant Liens on its assets to secure the Obligations, or (c) guarantee the Obligations; except for restrictions (i) existing under the Loan Documents, (ii) existing under Applicable Law, (iii) existing under agreements governing Capital Lease Obligations or purchase money Indebtedness (to the extent such restrictions apply only to the assets subject to such Capital Lease Obligation or purchase money Indebtedness), (iv) contained in agreements relating to the sale of a Subsidiary or its assets pending the consummation of such sale (to the extent permitted under Section 7.05), and (v) customary provisions in joint venture agreements and other similar agreements not materially more restrictive than is customary.

Use the proceeds of any Loan for any purpose other than as stated in Section 4.20. **[ARTICLE VIII --- EVENTS OF DEFAULT AND REMEDIES]**
**[Section 8.01 --- Events of Default]**
Each of the following shall constitute an \"**Event of Default**\":
\(a\) **Payment Defaults.** (i) The Borrower fails to pay any principal of any Loan or any reimbursement obligation in respect of any LC disbursement when due and payable, whether at stated maturity, by required prepayment, upon acceleration, demand, or otherwise; (ii) the Borrower fails to pay any interest on any Loan or any fee or any other amount (other than an amount referred to in clause (i)) payable under any Loan Document when due and payable and such failure continues for three (3) Business Days after the date on which such payment was due; or (iii) the Borrower fails to pay any other Obligation within five (5) Business Days after demand by the Administrative Agent.
\(b\) **Specific Covenant Defaults (No Cure Period).** Any Loan Party fails to perform or observe any term, covenant, or agreement contained in Section 7.01 (Liens), Section 7.02 (Indebtedness), Section 7.04 (Fundamental Changes), Section 7.06 (Restricted Payments), Section 7.10 (Capital Expenditures), or Section 7.11 (Financial Covenants).
\(c\) **Other Covenant Defaults.** Any Loan Party fails to perform or observe any other covenant or agreement (not specified in Section 8.01(a) or (b)) contained in any Loan Document and such failure continues for thirty (30) days after written notice thereof from the Administrative Agent to the Borrower (whether or not such notice is given at the direction of the Required Lenders).
\(d\) **Representation Defaults.** Any representation or warranty made or deemed made by any Loan Party in any Loan Document or in any document, certificate, or financial statement delivered in connection herewith or therewith proves to have been incorrect in any material respect (or, in the case of representations and warranties qualified by materiality or Material Adverse Effect, in any respect) when made or deemed made.
\(e\) **Cross-Default.** (i) Any Loan Party fails to make any payment when due (whether by scheduled maturity, required prepayment, acceleration, demand, or otherwise) in respect of any Indebtedness (other than Indebtedness under the Loan Documents) having an aggregate principal amount (including undrawn committed or available amounts and including amounts owing to all creditors under any combined or syndicated credit arrangement) in excess of \$2,500,000, or (ii) any other event or condition occurs that results in any such Indebtedness being declared due and payable prior to its scheduled maturity or that enables the holder thereof to declare such Indebtedness due and payable prior to its scheduled maturity.
\(f\) **Bankruptcy/Insolvency.** (i) Any Loan Party commences a voluntary case or other proceeding seeking liquidation, reorganization, or other relief under any Debtor Relief Law, or consents to the appointment of or taking possession by a receiver, liquidator, assignee, trustee, custodian, sequestrator, or other similar official of it or any substantial part of its property, or makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors; or (ii) an involuntary case or other proceeding is commenced against any Loan Party seeking liquidation, reorganization, or other relief under any Debtor Relief Law, and such involuntary case or proceeding remains undismissed and unstayed for a period of sixty (60) days; or (iii) an order for relief is entered against any Loan Party under the Bankruptcy Code of the United States.
\(g\) **Judgments.** One or more final, non-appealable judgments or orders for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding \$2,500,000 (to the extent not covered by independent third-party insurance as to which the insurer has acknowledged coverage in writing) are rendered against any Loan Party and such judgments or orders remain undischarged, unvacated, unbonded, or unstayed for a period of thirty (30) consecutive days after the date on which such judgments or orders became final.
\(h\) **ERISA Events.** One or more ERISA Events occur that have resulted or could reasonably be expected to result in aggregate liability to any Loan Party or ERISA Affiliate in excess of \$5,000,000.
\(i\) **Invalidity of Loan Documents.** (i) Any material provision of any Loan Document ceases to be in full force and effect (other than by reason of a release of Collateral or a Guarantor in accordance with the terms of the Loan Documents or the satisfaction in full of the Obligations), (ii) any Lien created by any Collateral Document ceases to be, or is asserted by any Loan Party not to be, a valid and perfected first-priority Lien (subject to Permitted Liens) on the applicable Collateral, or (iii) any Loan Party denies or disaffirms in writing its obligations under any Loan Document.
\(j\) **Change of Control.** The occurrence of a Change of Control.
\(k\) **Environmental Matters.** Any Environmental Liability is asserted against any Loan Party that, individually or in the aggregate, could reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.
**[Section 8.02 --- Remedies Upon Event of Default]**
\(a\) **Acceleration.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request or direction of the Required Lenders shall, by notice to the Borrower, declare all outstanding Obligations to be immediately due and payable, whereupon such Obligations shall become immediately due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest, or other notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by the Borrower and each other Loan Party; *provided* that upon the occurrence of any Event of Default described in Section 8.01(f), the outstanding Obligations shall automatically become immediately due and payable, without notice, presentment, demand, protest, or other formality of any kind.
\(b\) **Termination of Commitments.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request or direction of the Required Lenders shall, terminate the Revolving Commitments and the DDTL Commitments, and upon such termination the Lenders shall have no further obligation to make any Loans or issue any Letters of Credit.
\(c\) **Cash Collatera

lization of LCs.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Borrower shall, upon demand by the Administrative Agent, deposit in a cash collateral account maintained with the Administrative Agent an amount in cash equal to 103% of the aggregate undrawn amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit, which cash shall be held as collateral for the Borrower\'s reimbursement obligations in respect of such Letters of Credit.
\(d\) **Enforcement of Remedies.** Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request or direction of the Required Lenders shall, exercise any and all remedies available to the Secured Parties under the Loan Documents, under the UCC, under any other Applicable Law, or in equity, including (without limitation) the right to foreclose on the Collateral, collect any accounts receivable, sell any Collateral at public or private sale, and apply the proceeds thereof to the Obligations.
\(e\) **Application of Proceeds.** All proceeds received by the Administrative Agent from any enforcement action, realization upon Collateral, or other recovery shall be applied in the following order: *first*, to pay the fees, costs, and expenses of the Administrative Agent (including reasonable attorneys\' fees and expenses); *second*, to pay all accrued and unpaid fees owing to the Administrative Agent and the Lenders; *third*, to pay all accrued and unpaid interest on the Loans; *fourth*, to pay all outstanding principal of the Term Loans and Revolving Loans, applied *pro rata* based on the aggregate outstanding principal amounts thereof; *fifth*, to cash collateralize all outstanding LC Obligations at 103%; *sixth*, to pay all other Obligations that are then due and payable (including any Swap Obligations owing to Secured Parties); and *seventh*, any surplus remaining after payment in full of all Obligations shall be paid to the Borrower or as otherwise required by Applicable Law.
**[Section 8.03 --- Application of Funds]**
All funds received by the Administrative Agent for the account of the Lenders in connection with the exercise of remedies upon an Event of Default shall be applied in the order set forth in Section 8.02(e). The Administrative Agent shall have no duty to marshal any assets or to seek recovery from any particular item of Collateral before resorting to any other item of Collateral. Until all Obligations have been paid in full, the Administrative Agent shall have the sole and exclusive right to apply or reverse and re-apply any and all payments to any portion of the Obligations as the Administrative Agent may determine in its sole discretion in accordance with Section 8.02(e).
